assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent raster game sprite for a tiny 30–50 px square cell in an elegant pastoral logic puzzle.
Primary request: one small natural turquoise-blue pond, near-top-down view, organic rounded shoreline, subtle narrow pale sand bank, two tiny reeds and a few soft readable ripples, no animals.
Style/medium: original polished restrained hand-painted gouache and watercolor with fine dark forest-green ink accents; broad readable silhouette, few details, gentle pigment variation. Complement cream paper, pastel region colors and quiet fine-line chapter landscapes. This must be proper painted sprite art, not a crude wave outline icon.
Composition/framing: square image, isolated pond centered and occupying about 85% of canvas; near-top-down viewing angle; modest soft grounded shadow immediately around the shore.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with real alpha channel, transparent outside the pond and its narrow bank, no white backdrop.
Constraints: unmistakable at tiny size; no text, borders, UI, grid, checkerboard, white rectangular backdrop, animals, decorative surrounding scene, vector symbols, photorealism or glossy 3D.
assets.editPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target, an existing hand-painted pond sprite with a baked white/light-gray checkerboard.
Primary request: Remove the entire baked checkerboard background and replace it with genuinely transparent pixels in the PNG alpha channel. This is background extraction only.
Preserve invariants: Preserve the pond artwork exactly: turquoise water, all ripples and watercolor pigment, pale irregular bank, reeds, fine ink contours, original size, composition, colors, and square framing. Preserve fine painted edges and a modest immediate shore shadow with translucent alpha.
Constraints: Output an actual RGBA PNG with transparent empty surroundings, alpha zero outside the artwork. Do not paint, render, or simulate a checkerboard. No white background, no gray background, no replacement backdrop, no rectangular matte or halo. Do not restyle, redraw, add elements, crop the pond, or change the artwork. The existing checkerboard is unwanted image content and must be removed completely.
